definitions.gloss: person in charge; representative; contact person
definitions.explanation: The person responsible for handling a particular matter or task.

examples.japanese: {担当者|たんとうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please ask the person in charge.

examples.japanese: {担当者|たんとうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わりました→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The person in charge has changed.

examples.japanese: {担当者|たんとうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the name of the contact person.

notes:
{担当者|たんとうしゃ} is the person assigned to handle a specific task, account, or area. Very common in business and customer service contexts.

COMPOUND: ⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧ (charge, responsibility) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {担当者|たんとうしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡する：20202_renrakusuru⟧: to contact the person in charge
- {担当者|たんとうしゃ}⟦{不在|ふざい}→不在：11302_fuzai⟧: the person in charge is absent
- {営業|えいぎょう}{担当者|たんとうしゃ}: sales representative
- {担当者|たんとうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the person in charge

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: charge, responsibility (the role itself, not the person)
- ⟦{責任者|せきにんしゃ}→責任者：17175_sekininsha⟧: person responsible (emphasizes accountability, often higher rank)
- ⟦{係|かかり}→係：02552_kakari⟧: person in charge (often for specific duties within an organization)
